audit_name: EXP-07 Loss Weighting and Class Mapping Canonicalization Audit
dataset_basis: 132 OPS02 TRAIN sample pairs (8,595,330 valid pixels)

c18_discrepancy_forensics.c18_markdown_error: Section 8 of EXP07_P0_C18 report presented normalized weights with incorrect class labels ('MCC=1.13, WS=1.19, AS=1.58, HM=0.32, Thermal=0.28').
c18_discrepancy_forensics.root_cause: A post-processing script during C18 report compilation computed normalized sum-to-12 weights using an altered taxonomy ordering and wrote those into the markdown report text.
c18_discrepancy_forensics.resolution: Confirmed that the machine-readable audit ops02_c18_class_weights_audit_v1.json contains the exact unnormalized sqrt-median weights [0.403935 ... 18.243211] matching C15 and C16 exactly. The markdown table is declared a reporting error and superseded by this canonical audit.
